big_case.notes: Independent read: a Solicitor General application to stay injunctions against a presidential executive order restructuring federal election administration, granted roughly ten weeks before the 2026 midterms, with a same-day response call, supplemental briefing, full-Court referral, and heavy amicus participation. Near the ceiling of the interim docket's stakes: separation of powers, federal-state control of elections, and immediate nationwide effect on election rules.
